changeSet.sql:
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_report_loan_general;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_report_loan_general AS SELECT -- m_loan columns ml.*,
-- Informacion Adicional ia.codigo_promotor AS "ia.codigo_promotor", ia.nombre_aliado AS "ia.nombre_aliado", ia.numero_identificacion_aliado AS "ia.numero_identificacion_aliado", ia.ciudad_aliado AS "ia.ciudad_aliado", ia.verificacion_riesgo AS "ia.verificacion_riesgo", ia.tipo_identificacion AS "ia.tipo_identificacion", ia.numero_identificacion AS "ia.numero_identificacion", ia.dias_mora_ini_mes AS "ia.dias_mora_ini_mes", ia.fecha_registro_dias_mora_ini_mes AS "ia.fecha_registro_dias_mora_ini_mes", ia.validacion_manual AS "ia.validacion_manual", ia.fecha_primer_uso AS "ia.fecha_primer_uso", ia.codigo_promotor_original AS "ia.codigo_promotor_original", ia.nombre_promotor AS "ia.nombre_promotor", ia.ciudad_cliente AS "ia.ciudad_cliente", ia.notificacion_bienvenida AS "ia.notificacion_bienvenida", ia.departamento_cliente AS "ia.departamento_cliente", ia.monto_disponible AS "ia.monto_disponible", ia.fullname_referer AS "ia.fullname_referer", ia.modelo_externo AS "ia.modelo_externo", ia.created_at AS "ia.created_at", ia.updated_at AS "ia.updated_at",
-- Informacion Bancaria ib.entidad_financiera AS "ib.entidad_financiera", ib.tipo_de_cuenta AS "ib.tipo_de_cuenta", ib.numero_de_cuenta AS "ib.numero_de_cuenta", ib.created_at AS "ib.created_at", ib.updated_at AS "ib.updated_at",
-- Informacion Financiera ifi.ingresos AS "ifi.ingresos", ifi.activos AS "ifi.activos", ifi.created_at AS "ifi.created_at", ifi.updated_at AS "ifi.updated_at",
-- Alianzas al.estado AS "al.estado", al.valor_real AS "al.valor_real", al.pendiente_conciliacion AS "al.pendiente_conciliacion", al.fecha_creacion AS "al.fecha_creacion", al.valor_real_aprobado AS "al.valor_real_aprobado", al.store_alliance AS "al.store_alliance", al.sticker_note AS "al.sticker_note", al.value_buy AS "al.value_buy", al.commission_alliance AS "al.commission_alliance", al.percentage_commission AS "al.percentage_commission", al.tax_commission_alliance AS "al.tax_commission_alliance", al.provider_order_id AS "al.provider_order_id", al.created_at AS "al.created_at", al.updated_at AS "al.updated_at",
-- Estado Cartera ec."Tipo Bloqueo_cd_Tipo Bloqueo" AS "ec.Tipo Bloqueo_cd_Tipo Bloqueo", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(ec."Tipo Bloqueo_cd_Tipo Bloqueo") AS "ec.Tipo Bloqueo_description", ec.fecha_bloqueo AS "ec.fecha_bloqueo", ec.reestructurado AS "ec.reestructurado", ec.fecha_reestructurado AS "ec.fecha_reestructurado", ec.negociaciones AS "ec.negociaciones", ec.salvamento AS "ec.salvamento", ec.obs_salvamento AS "ec.obs_salvamento", ec."Casa Cobranzas Asignada_cd_Casa Cobranzas Asignada" AS "ec.Casa Cobranzas Asignada_cd_Casa Cobranzas Asignada", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(ec."Casa Cobranzas Asignada_cd_Casa Cobranzas Asignada") AS "ec.Cobranzas Asignada", ec.created_at AS "ec.created_at", ec.updated_at AS "ec.updated_at",
-- Validacion Operacion vo.correo_validado AS "vo.correo_validado", vo.no_celular_validado AS "vo.no_celular_validado", vo.alerta_direccion AS "vo.alerta_direccion", vo.credito_vigente AS "vo.credito_vigente", vo.observacion_operaciones AS "vo.observacion_operaciones", vo."SiNoNoAplica_cd_retanqueo" AS "vo.SiNoNoAplica_cd_retanqueo", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(vo."SiNoNoAplica_cd_retanqueo") AS "vo.retanqueo", vo.fecha_retanqueo AS "vo.fecha_retanqueo", vo."SiNoNoAplica_cd_Cliente_existe" AS "vo.SiNoNoAplica_cd_Cliente_existe", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(vo."SiNoNoAplica_cd_Cliente_existe") AS "vo.Cliente_existe", vo."Tipo Credito_cd_Tipo Credito" AS "vo.Tipo Credito_cd_Tipo Credito", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(vo."Tipo Credito_cd_Tipo Credito") AS "vo.Tipo Credito", vo.created_at AS "vo.created_at", vo.updated_at AS "vo.updated_at",
-- Visita vi.req_visita AS "vi.req_visita", vi."Resultado Visita_cd_Resultado Visita" AS "vi.Resultado Visita_cd_Resultado Visita", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(vi."Resultado Visita_cd_Resultado Visita") AS "vi.Resultado Visita", vi."Canal de Visita_cd_Canal de Visita" AS "vi.Canal de Visita_cd_Canal de Visita", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(vi."Canal de Visita_cd_Canal de Visita") AS "vi.Canal de Visita", vi."Causal Rechazo Visita_cd_Causal Rechazo Visita" AS "vi.Causal Rechazo Visita_cd_Causal Rechazo Visita", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(vi."Causal Rechazo Visita_cd_Causal Rechazo Visita") AS "vi.Causal Rechazo Visita", vi.entrevista_fallida AS "vi.entrevista_fallida", vi.created_at AS "vi.created_at", vi.updated_at AS "vi.updated_at",
-- Validacion Seguridad vs."Validacion Seguridad_cd_Validacion Seguridad" AS "vs.Validacion Seguridad_cd_Validacion Seguridad", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(vs."Validacion Seguridad_cd_Validacion Seguridad") AS "vs.Validacion Seguridad", vs."Causal Rechazo Seguridad_cd_Causal Rechazo Seguridad" AS "vs.Causal Rechazo Seguridad_cd_Causal Rechazo Seguridad", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(vs."Causal Rechazo Seguridad_cd_Causal Rechazo Seguridad") AS "vs.Causal Rechazo Seguridad", vs.seguridad_fallida AS "vs.seguridad_fallida", vs.observacion_seguridad AS "vs.observacion_seguridad", vs.created_at AS "vs.created_at", vs.updated_at AS "vs.updated_at",
-- Detalle garantia dg.loan_id AS "dg.loan_id", dg.aplica_garantia AS "dg.aplica_garantia", dg."Tipo Garantía_cd_Tipo Garantía" AS "dg.Tipo Garantía_cd_Tipo Garantía", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(dg."Tipo Garantía_cd_Tipo Garantía") AS "dg.Tipo Garantía", dg."Tipo Producto_cd_Tipo Producto" AS "dg.Tipo Producto_cd_Tipo Producto", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(dg."Tipo Producto_cd_Tipo Producto") AS "dg.Tipo Producto", dg.porc_comision AS "dg.porc_comision", dg.porc_cobertura AS "dg.porc_cobertura", dg.numero_garantia AS "dg.numero_garantia", dg.fecha_registro_garantia AS "dg.fecha_registro_garantia", dg.fecha_reserva AS "dg.fecha_reserva", dg.fecha_cancelacion AS "dg.fecha_cancelacion", dg."Estado Garantía_cd_Estado Garantía" AS "dg.Estado Garantía_cd_Estado Garantía", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(dg."Estado Garantía_cd_Estado Garantía") AS "dg.Estado Garantía", dg.obs_estado_garantia AS "dg.obs_estado_garantia", dg.numero_pagare AS "dg.numero_pagare", dg.created_at AS "dg.created_at", dg.updated_at AS "dg.updated_at" FROM m_loan ml LEFT JOIN "Informacion Adicional" ia ON ml.id = ia.loan_id LEFT JOIN "Informacion Bancaria" ib ON ml.id = ib.loan_id LEFT JOIN "Informacion Financiera" ifi ON ml.id = ifi.loan_id LEFT JOIN "Alianzas" al ON ml.id = al.loan_id LEFT JOIN "Estado Cartera" ec ON ml.id = ec.loan_id LEFT JOIN "Validacion Operacion" vo ON ml.id = vo.loan_id LEFT JOIN "Visita" vi ON ml.id = vi.loan_id LEFT JOIN "Validacion Seguridad" vs ON ml.id = vs.loan_id LEFT JOIN "Detalle garanta" dg ON ml.id = dg.loan_id;

changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.sql:
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_report_loan_general;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_report_loan_general AS SELECT ml.*, dg.loan_id AS "dg.loan_id", dg.aplica_garantia AS "dg.aplica_garantia", dg."Tipo Garantía_cd_Tipo Garantía" AS "dg.Tipo Garantía_cd_Tipo Garantía", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(dg."Tipo Garantía_cd_Tipo Garantía") AS "dg.Tipo Garantía", dg."Tipo Producto_cd_Tipo Producto" AS "dg.Tipo Producto_cd_Tipo Producto", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(dg."Tipo Producto_cd_Tipo Producto") AS "dg.Tipo Producto", dg.porc_comision AS "dg.porc_comision", dg.porc_cobertura AS "dg.porc_cobertura", dg.numero_garantia AS "dg.numero_garantia", dg.fecha_registro_garantia AS "dg.fecha_registro_garantia", dg.fecha_reserva AS "dg.fecha_reserva", dg.fecha_cancelacion AS "dg.fecha_cancelacion", dg."Estado Garantía_cd_Estado Garantía" AS "dg.Estado Garantía_cd_Estado Garantía", fn_core_codevalue_getdescription(dg."Estado Garantía_cd_Estado Garantía") AS "dg.Estado Garantía", dg.obs_estado_garantia AS "dg.obs_estado_garantia", dg.numero_pagare AS "dg.numero_pagare", dg.created_at AS "dg.created_at", dg.updated_at AS "dg.updated_at" FROM m_loan ml LEFT JOIN "Detalle garantía" dg ON ml.id = dg.loan_id;
